verses.gurmukhi: ਚਾਰਿ ਵਰਨਿ ਇਕ ਵਰਨ ਕਰਿ ਵਰਨ ਅਵਰਨ ਤਮੋਲ ਗੁਲਾਲੇ।
verses.translit_en: chaar varan ik varan kar varan avaran tamol gulaale|

en.bdb: As in betel leaf all the colours mix and become one red colour, likewise mixing all the varnas one Sikh has been created.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਸਟ ਧਾਤੁ ਇਕੁ ਧਾਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਦ ਕਤੇਬ ਨ ਭੇਦੁ ਵਿਚਾਲੇ।
verses.translit_en: asaT dhaat ik dhaat kar vedh kateb na bhedh vichaale|

en.bdb: Eight metals mixing up make one metal (alloy); similarly there is no difference among Vedas and the Katebas (the Semitic scriptures).

verses.gurmukhi: ਚੰਦਨ ਵਾਸੁ ਵਣਾਸੁਪਤਿ ਅਫਲ ਸਫਲ ਵਿਚਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਬਹਾਲੇ।
verses.translit_en: cha(n)dhan vaas vanaasupat afal safal vich vaas bahaale|

en.bdb: The sandal perfumes the whole vegetation whether it is devoid of fruit or full of fruit.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲੋਹਾ ਸੁਇਨਾ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਸੁਇਨਾ ਹੋਇ ਸੁਗੰਧਿ ਵਿਖਾਲੇ।
verses.translit_en: lohaa suinaa hoi kai suinaa hoi suga(n)dh vikhaale|

en.bdb: Touching the philosopher’s stone, iron becoming gold, again points towards its further beauty (of making itself useful for the needy ones).

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁਇਨੇ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਰੰਗ ਰਸ ਚਰਣਾਮਿਤ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਮਤਵਾਲੇ।
verses.translit_en: suine a(n)dhar ra(n)g ras charanaamit a(n)mrit matavaale|

en.bdb: Then in gold in the form of gurmukh, the colour (of Name) and elixir (of love) enter and he becomes carefree of the world around.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਾਣਕ ਮੋਤੀ ਸੁਇਨਿਅਹੁ ਜਗਮਗ ਜੋਤਿ ਹੀਰੇ ਪਰਵਾਲੇ।
verses.translit_en: maanak motee suiniahu jagamag jot heere paravaale|

en.bdb: Now all the qualities of rubies, pearls, diamonds emerge in that gold-gurmukh.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦਿਬ ਦੇਹਿ ਦਿਬ ਦਿਸਟਿ ਹੋਇ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਦਿਬ ਜੋਤਿ ਉਜਾਲੇ।
verses.translit_en: dhib dheh dhib dhisaT hoi sabadh surat dhib jot ujaale|

en.bdb: Becoming divine body and divine sight the consciousness of gurmukh concentrates on the light of the divine Word.
Thus, adopting the delight of devotion, the gurmukhs become full of many delights.
